description: Update shop-facing fields of a product: hideFromDiscovery (show/hide in the public /gift directory), and `kindOf` for operational edits. More broadly this is the merchant-facing "show/hide" for discovery — what the sales/manage products tab does. Pricing of a rikma product is a term and belongs in editObject with rikma consent (§4.6); this tool says so and returns the edit URL when asked to change price on such a product. For discovery, the change applies at once. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#updateRikmaProductTool

hideFromDiscovery.description: Hide it from /gift directory (true) or show it again (false).

name.description: New display name (for personal products this applies at once; for rikma products it is a term).

name: updateRikmaProductTool
